body: Love and weight came as a package for you. Affection can feel serious here. Love may seem precious because it also feels conditional, delayed, or easy to lose. You don't fall lightly. You commit, or you stay out. Love may feel tied to terms, timing, or proof. This can make affection feel meaningful, but not always easy to receive. As an adult you may choose duty over warmth, hold back to stay safe, or quietly believe you're not built for the easy kind. You're the one who stays when others leave. But you can stay your whole life and still keep yourself locked out. Letting yourself be loved is the harder part. The work is receiving without an invoice attached.
gift: At your best: loyal, committed, the realest kind of devotion there is.
shadow: The trap: rationing affection, and believing love only counts if it cost you something.
integration: Let love and values and discipline and limits cooperate without making either one carry the whole story. Loyal and hardworking; the risk is joyless striving and a belief that reward must be suffered for.
do: Choose warmth over duty on purpose
Say the fear that love gets taken away
dont: Wait to feel worthy before you let it in
